summary.text: Wayne Raasch is running as a write-in independent candidate for Texas's 27th District after receiving 7.5% in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for the seat. Ballotpedia lists him as a repeat Democratic primary candidate for Texas offices since 2016.

paragraphs.text: Raasch first appears in Ballotpedia's record in the 2016 Democratic primary for Texas's 27th District, which Roy Barrera won.
On March 1, 2022, he ran in the Democratic primary for Texas State Board of Education District 2 and received 5.4% of the vote.
He lost the March 5, 2024 Democratic primary for Texas's 22nd District, receiving 18.3% of the vote.
In the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for the 27th District he received 7.5%, then filed as a write-in independent for the general election.
